name: aws
notes: Official AWS command-line interface; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles.

name: granted
notes: AWS access utility; the assume shell integration is provided by Granted.

name: aws cdk cli
notes: Official AWS CDK Toolkit CLI; installs the cdk executable.

name: aws sam cli
notes: Official AWS SAM CLI; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles.

name: cfn-lint
notes: CloudFormation template linter from Homebrew core.

name: iamlive
notes: IAM policy generator; its official tap explicitly provides amd64 and arm64 Linux artifacts.

name: session-manager-plugin
notes: Official AWS Debian payload, extracted user-locally without maintainer scripts or host writes. The package declares only libc6; the command points directly to its relocatable Go executable, while systemd/upstart files in the payload are inert.

name: checkov
notes: Infrastructure-as-code security scanner from Homebrew core.

name: gitleaks
notes: Secret scanner from Homebrew core.

name: age
notes: File encryption tool from Homebrew core.

name: just
notes: Command runner from Homebrew core.

name: actionlint
notes: GitHub Actions workflow linter from Homebrew core.

name: ruff
notes: Python linter and formatter from Homebrew core.

name: shellcheck
notes: Shell script static analyzer from Homebrew core.

name: shfmt
notes: Shell formatter from Homebrew core.

name: typos
notes: Source-code spell checker; Homebrew formula is named typos-cli and installs typos.

name: mise
notes: Polyglot tool-version manager from Homebrew core.

name: uv
notes: Python package and project manager from Homebrew core.

name: yaml-py
notes: Matches the Mac setup's dedicated yaml-py helper: an isolated uv-managed Python interpreter with PyYAML importable, not the unrelated python-yq CLI.

name: tsc
notes: Official TypeScript package; installs the tsc compiler.

name: tsx
notes: TypeScript execution runtime from npm.

name: chezmoi
notes: Dotfile manager from Homebrew core.

name: cheznav
notes: Chezmoi TUI published on PyPI; requires Python 3.14 or newer.

name: libreoffice
notes: Verified Flathub build of the LibreOffice suite; soffice is its command name, not a separate application.

name: draw.io
notes: Linux desktop application published on Flathub.

name: imagemagick
notes: Image manipulation tools from Homebrew core.

name: oxiping
notes: The requested oxiping spelling resolves to oxipng, the multithreaded PNG optimizer in Homebrew core.

name: jpegoptim
notes: JPEG optimizer from Homebrew core.

name: VLC
notes: VLC media player via Flathub.

name: caligula
notes: Official checksum-pinned Linux release executables avoid Caligula's bindgen, C compiler, and native compression-library source-build requirements.

name: chamber
notes: AWS SSM Parameter Store secrets CLI from Homebrew core.

name: kitty
notes: Official checksum-pinned Linux binary bundle; extraction preserves Kitty's required directory layout and exposes kitty and kitten through wrappers.

name: bitwarden
notes: Officially verified Bitwarden desktop package on Flathub.

name: Bruno
notes: Official pinned Debian desktop payloads for x86_64 and aarch64, extracted user-locally without maintainer scripts or host writes; unlike the publisher-documented Flatpak, which currently supports only x86_64, the native payload uses host libraries and can access local collections and host tooling.

name: gitlogue
notes: Animated Git history replay; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64. Requires Git and a repository with commit history.

name: VisiData
notes: Terminal tabular-data explorer, exposed as vd and visidata. Homebrew core provides an architecture-independent bottle and manages its Python environment; formats such as XLSX and Parquet need optional dependencies not provisioned by setup.

name: dnsglobe
notes: DNS propagation TUI; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64 without an extra tap. Requires outbound access to public DNS resolvers; no firewall or capability changes are applied.

name: oxker
notes: Docker container TUI; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64. Requires access to an existing Docker daemon, which can be root-equivalent; setup does not change groups, sockets, services, or contexts.

name: llmfit
notes: Hardware-aware LLM recommendations; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64. GPU detection depends on host drivers and probes; setup does not download models or start services.

name: croc
notes: Encrypted file transfer; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64. Transfers require network access and can use public relays; protect transfer codes. No relay or automatic transfers are configured.

name: grex
notes: Generates regular expressions from examples; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64. Review generated expressions for unintended matches and target-engine compatibility.

name: kondo
notes: CLI for deleting project dependencies and build artifacts; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64. Cleanup is destructive and must be invoked explicitly by the user; setup never runs it or installs kondo-ui.

name: Worktrunk
notes: Git worktree manager exposed as wt; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64. Requires Git and conflicts with wiredtiger's wt executable. Shell integration, project hooks, agent plugins, and LLM providers are not configured.

name: Jetbrains mono nerd font
notes: Checksum-verified Nerd Fonts release archive; installer deploys only font files to the user font directory.
